## Penguin Solutions to Present at Barclays 24th Annual Global Technology Conference


November 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://ir.penguinsolutions.com/files/doc_news/Penguin-Solutions-to-Present-at-Barclays-24th-Annual-Global-Technology-Conference-2026.pdf)


FREMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Penguin Solutions, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.penguinsolutions.com%2Fen-us&esheet=54644951&newsitemid=20261123349025&lan=en-US&anchor=Penguin+Solutions%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=9d8b46fc4eab0bc2656b333a16bd2a7d) (Nasdaq:[PENG](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.penguinsolutions.com%2Fstock-information%2Fstock-quote-and-charts%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54644951&newsitemid=20261123349025&lan=en-US&anchor=PENG&index=2&md5=613483d2f9c524de9d7ad60cbd3a8eb2) ), the AI Factory Platform Company, announced that Kash Shaikh, CEO of Penguin Solutions, will participate in a fireside chat at the following investor conference:


**What:**


**Barclays 24th Annual Global Technology Conference**


**Who:**


**Kash Shaikh, CEO of Penguin Solutions**


**When:**


**December 10, 2026 at 12:50 PM Pacific Time**


An event webcast will be accessible in the events section of the Penguin Solutions investor relations website at[IR Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.penguinsolutions.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54644951&newsitemid=20261123349025&lan=en-US&anchor=IR+Events&index=3&md5=cdffde97e4ce2abd82287bd9b5d223f2) and archived on the investor relations website for a period of 30 days.


**About Penguin Solutions**


Penguin Solutions is the AI Factory Platform Company. We design, build, and manage next-generation data centers for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and AI cloud providers.


With deep design expertise at the intersection of data center AI infrastructure and memory solutions, our Full-Stack AI Factory Platform combines differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner technologies to help customers accelerate deployment, optimize token economics, and maximize the return on their AI investments.


Learn more at[PenguinSolutions.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.penguinsolutions.com%2Fen-us&esheet=54644951&newsitemid=20261123349025&lan=en-US&anchor=PenguinSolutions.com&index=4&md5=45257f6b5876420460ec2ab85ea22f52) .
